question: The Mumbai High region in Arabian Sea is known for mining ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **mineral oil**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mumbai High region** is a significant offshore oil field located in the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• It is primarily known for the extraction of **mineral oil**, which includes crude oil and natural gas.
 
• The region was discovered in **1974** and has been a major contributor to India's oil production.
